topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Of course, I hadn’t expected such a request, but there it was, floating in the air between us like a colorful soap bubble. The idea of my yard, a place so familiar and constant, becoming a patch of shared earth, seemed almost whimsical. I nodded, watching the contours of my lawn transform in my mind into rows of green, budding life. "Certainly, you can use part of the yard for your garden," I found myself saying, my words threading through the unusual twist of this morning. It felt as if the boundaries of my space were gently stretching, making room for more than just plants, but for connections I hadn’t envisioned.
